name: Composite Image Loss with Visibility Weighting
definition: The total loss function used for training, combining image reconstruction losses weighted by visibility, perceptual loss, and regularization terms for sampling coordinates and visibility map.
summary: Composite Image Loss with Visibility Weighting is a training objective that modulates photometric terms by a visibility mask to suppress errors in occluded regions, distinguishing it from standard losses by focusing supervision on visible foreground content.
